notes: V2.2 RECOMMENDED STARTING POINT -- see Trade Study/V2.2_injector_trade_study.pdf. Sized on mdot_ox = 1.0 kg/s (well-conditioned; never inverts the regression law), not on O/F. 41 x 1.20 mm holes in a 12.7 mm plate give L/D 10.58, inside the band where the Waxman/NASA cold-flow data validates HEM. 1.0 kg/s is chosen over the top of the 1.0-1.5 kg/s range because the extra 4.3% Isp there costs 51% more oxidiser flux (already past the fitted correlation range), drops the clean pressure-drop margin from 84% to 60% of the burn, and leaves 7 more points of fuel unburnt. Regression a/n are HRAP defaults and NOT measured: expect O/F anywhere in 4-12. Cold-flow the plate to measure Cd before committing.
